Message: Second physical coil from TP1 trial (not schematic label L2): mark its current ferrite position, then move that ferrite approximately 0.25 mm inward toward the coil center; do not pass the center or force it. Keep the first physical coil centered, all capacitors and remaining coils unchanged. Keep cables and sweep settings unchanged. Remove hand/tool and click Done - measure. Skip if the coil cannot be identified or adjusted.
